M3.reason: Parts the brief asks for: (1) the case, one box with a flat bottom and the lid on top; (2) one red cross, centred on the lid in the top view and on the top in the oblique views; (3) FIRST AID lettering on the 26-wide front face, reading correctly in the front view and the front-left and front-right oblique views; (4) one carry strap, a black band running along the 35-long lid, offset toward one edge in the top view. The case has a subtle bevel line along its top edges, as the brief does not ask for any other detail, so nothing is added that looks wrong.

The asset was picked as the odd one out in one of four readings (the third), so it passed for one of the game's in three of four, which is the bar for a 2.

The bottom view shows a flat underside that rests on the floor, consistent with lying on the origin.
